text:
Noah: Dropping a compact one-pager draft for the field 1: security + SLA choices across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need: 30s hook, 3 decision signals, tiny benchmark panel, compliance bullets, CTA. Link: https://docs.google.com/internal/onepager (internal)
Rina: Nice layout. Can we surface a single-row tradeoff visual (Latency | Predictability | Isolation) but keep each cell to 2-4 words so it fits a slide?
Ken: Add recommended customer signals under each mode. e.g., Hosted = pilot or low-volume; Dedicated = steady throughput & contractual SLAs; Private = regulated or air-gapped. One line each.
Talia: Ops asks for a micro failover story for the webinar slide: primary pool -> canary -> fallback pool with compatible model variant. Keep it non-technical for PMs.
Marta: Compliance edits: call out SOC2, customer-managed KMS, optional HSM, and audit log retention. Tone: customer-facing, not legalese.
Noah: Benchmarks: can someone give 2 bullet workload callouts? e-commerce pilot (10k msgs/day) and finserv scale (50k msgs/day) with p95 short-chat latencies and a back-of-envelope $/1k-token delta per mode. One sentence each.
Ken: I'll flatten numbers into a one-line panel. Example: "Ecomm pilot (10k/day): p95 ~120ms on Hosted; Dedicated ~+15% cost; Private varies."
Talia: For the canary snippet, ops suggests slide-friendly YAML: ```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  watch: 30m
  fallback: enabled
```
Marta: Wording tweak: use "target SLA" and "near-identical fallback" to avoid absolutes. Add escalation path: "Support -> 1hr P1 response; dedicated account escalation available."
Noah: Inbound routing: SalesOps needs a CSV mapping so leads auto-tag by deploy interest and compliance need. Suggested headers: email,company,deploy_interest,compliance_flag,estimated_monthly_tokens. Who can produce?
Rina: I can export the tag CSV and a short mapping doc by Thu noon.
Ken: For webinar landing copy: two bullets only. I'll draft: 1) "Balance latency, cost, and compliance" 2) "Live failover demo + benchmarks"
Talia: Add a 30s host script: 1) problem (unpredictable cost/latency + regs), 2) Redwood solution (unified runtime, smart routing, fallbacks), 3) CTA (book 20-min field demo). Keep under 50 words.
Marta: Final compliance sweep tonight. Removing any legalese and ensuring KMS/HSM lines are accurate.
Noah: CTA on the one-pager: "Book a 20-min field demo" + a small qualification checklist for Dedicated trial (min monthly tokens, compliance requirements).
Rina: Timeline: need final PDF for promo batch Friday 08:00. Can everyone sign off by Thu EOD?
Ken: I can lock benchmarks and the CSV by Thu 3pm.
Talia: I'll finalize the host script and slide arc by Thu 6pm.
Marta: Compliance sign-off by Thu 7pm.
ops-bot: Note: linked doc was updated 9 minutes ago by Noah
Noah: Thanks team 1. I'll merge edits and post the final PDF here Thursday night. :white_check_mark:
